The packet also prohibits quantified effects unless an authorized fact explicitly supplies the number.

assessments.rationale: CH-U001-001 accurately presents the feedback-signal claim and behavioral mechanism supported by SRC-U001-CLAIM-001 and SRC-U001-MECHANISM-001, so the target is partially supported and remains within the mechanistic ceiling. Its additional source attribution concerning a 2018 sample of 47 participants lacks support in SRC-U001-ANCHOR-001 and violates the numerical-evidence restriction in SRC-U001-ATOMIC-016.

chapterEvidenceSpans: The source states: The Facebook Like button turned social approval into a quick, measurable feedback signal. Because a tap creates visible feedback with almost no effort, users gain reasons to post more often and return to check reactions. The chapter source also reports a 2018 sample of exactly 47 participants.
